:::{#hero-heading}

I'm a researcher in the OHSU Knight Cancer Institute specializing in the development of novel methods of specialized cancer diagnosis and treatment. Laboratory and analytic techniques primarily involve spatial proteomics/transcriptomics, immunofluorescent staining and high-level imaging. Currently obtaining an M.S. in Biostatistics with the goal of bringing my laboratory expertise to the computational side of research at OHSU.

When I'm not in the lab, you can find me tinkering with cars and motorcycles, camping in my Astro van at Hood or on the coast, building upgrades for said van, skating, snowboarding, surfing, playing guitar, or some frantic combination of all of the above.
